claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + MagicItemMechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord only covers spell | class_feature | mastery. There is no magic_item kind at all. The entire record shape, mechanics header, and family taxonomy are missing.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Weapon (Glaive, Greatsword, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, Sickle, or Shortsword), Legendary (Requires Attunement)

claude_proposed_widenings.name: dawn reset cadence in RestResetCadence
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Both Luck and Wish properties reset 'until the next dawn'. RestResetCadence has short_or_long_rest, long_rest, short_rest, partial_short_full_long — none covers a dawn-based reset, which is the standard magic item recharge cadence.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_item_bonus family (always-on numeric modifier while wielded/on person)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The +1 attack/damage (while wielded) and +1 saving throws (while on person) are persistent, passive bonuses — not activations, not concentration. No existing ClassFeatureMechanics or MasteryMechanics family captures an always-on numeric modifier on attack rolls, damage rolls, and saving throws granted by an equipped item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While the weapon is on your person, you also gain a +1 bonus to saving throws.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: charge-based spell casting (item charges, expend 1 to cast a named spell)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Wish property requires a charge resource with a randomised initial count (1d3) that is not refilled — charges are destroyed, and when 0 remain the property itself is destroyed. The charge atom exists in v4 but the surface has no family for 'expend charge -> cast named spell from item', nor for a destructible item property.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The weapon has 1d3 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge and cast Wish from it. [...] The weapon loses this property if it has no charges.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: reroll_failed_d20_test (triggered by failed D20 Test, must-use-second-roll constraint)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Luck property is 'reroll one failed D20 Test, must use the second roll.' The modify_roll_reroll atom exists in v4 but the surface type has no shape for 'triggered on a failed roll' (as opposed to a general reroll) and no constraint encoding 'must use second roll'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can call on its luck (no action required) to reroll one failed D20 Test if you don't have the Incapacitated condition. You must use the second roll.
